## Motivation

The `_sgemm_lora_b_kernel` Triton kernel had several performance inefficiencies:

1. **Unconditional output read-modify-write**: Every tile always loaded the output tensor before storing, even when the output was freshly zero-initialised (no `base_output`). This wasted one full global memory read per tile.

## Purpose

With async scheduling, `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90` did a blocking D2H copy on every metadata build. FlashInfer bakes each row's `kv_len` into its schedule on the host, and `seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound` is optimistic under async spec decode, so the builder copied `positions` / `seq_lens` back to get exact lengths. ## Purpose

This PR introduces xxHash-based hash algorithms to vLLM’s prefix caching, providing a faster and collision-resistant alternative to the SHA-256 variants added in #23673.

title: [Core] add option to schedule requests based on full ISL
body:
## Purpose
The default behaviour of vLLM is to schedule requests if the first chunk of a request fits.

Observed problematic behavior (ISL numbers are mocked because this is customer data): When 4×100k ISL requests already occupy ~90% of the KV cache, the scheduler still admits a 5th 100k ISL request. Fixes a latent 0/0 → NaN in the torch top-k renormalization paths — the same defect class as flashinfer-ai/flashinfer#3803 ("Fix 0/0 NaN in GLM52 Routing Renorm") and part of the fallout analyzed in #30989.

title: [perf] Quantize TRTLLM MLA prefill Q once for chunked-prefix attention
body:
## Motivation

When TRTLLM MLA prefill uses FP8 attention, `_run_prefill_kernel` converts Q/K/V to FP8 before each attention call.

For chunked-prefix attention, the same query tensor is consumed by both suffix attention and every prefix-chunk attention call. This causes the same Q tensor to be converted from BF16 to FP8 repeatedly within one layer forward.

For a request with `N` prefix chunks, this change reduces Q conversion from `N + 1` times to once. K/V remain call-specific and keep their existing quantization behavior.

This is intentionally narrower than the fused prefill preparation introduced in #25460. It does not change RoPE, KV-cache writes, K/V packing, or the attention kernel.
